title.value: Enabling Realtime Reinforcement Learning at Scale with Staggered Asynchronous Inference
title.justification: The title is clearly mentioned at the beginning of the paper.
title.quote: E NABLING R EALTIME R EINFORCEMENT L EARNING AT S CALE WITH S TAGGERED A SYNCHRONOUS I NFERENCE

analysis.description: This paper analyzes lower bounds on regret in realtime reinforcement learning environments, exploring the scalability of asynchronous compute. It proposes and tests novel algorithms for staggered asynchronous inference to ensure consistent action intervals, with applications to large-scale models, specifically in the context of realtime games like Pokémon and Tetris.

type.justification: The paper presents a theoretical analysis of lower bounds on regret in RL environments and proposes novel algorithms for staggered asynchronous inference.
type.quote: We present an analysis of lower bounds on regret in realtime reinforcement learning (RL) environments... We propose novel algorithms for staggering asynchronous inference processes...
